summary: Frontend-only e2e testing for LIBRA 3D Printing marketplace prototype. Tested all 13 requested flows across 9 routes (Home, Shop, Categories, ProductDetail, CustomOrders, Checkout, Contact, About, Admin) plus navigation, cart, mobile menu and footer. 30+ assertions covered: nav links navigate correctly, shop has 8 products with all filters working (category, material, color, price, availability, rating), sort orders correctly (low/high/best/newest), URL category pre-select works, categories page renders 7 cards and links to /shop?category=<id>, product detail interactions (thumbs/color/qty/tabs/add-to-cart) work, cart drawer auto-opens on add-to-cart with qty controls + remove + subtotal updates, checkout shows validation toast for missing fields and personalized success state, custom orders + contact forms show toast on empty and personalized success on submit, admin dashboard renders all key elements (orders table, products table, add product button), mobile menu toggle works, footer present on every route. 0 console errors observed. Overall app is production-quality for a prototype.

integration_issues.issue: CartContext is in-memory only — refreshing/direct-loading /checkout loses cart and shows empty-cart state. Acceptable for a prototype but recommend persisting to localStorage so checkout deep-links and refreshes are functional.

action_items: (Optional polish) Persist cart to localStorage so refresh / direct /checkout deep-link doesn't reset to empty state.

(Optional) Categories page lists 'Custom Prints' which routes to /shop?category=custom-prints — no products exist for that id, so user sees a 0-results empty state. Consider redirecting 'Custom Prints' card to /custom-orders instead, or seed a sample product.
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext should persist to localStorage (or sessionStorage) so cart survives reload — currently in-memory only.
Checkout empty-cart branch has no data-testid; consider adding data-testid='checkout-empty' for testability.
Categories 'custom-prints' card links to /shop with a category that has no matching products — minor UX dead-end.
Shop sort 'newest' is implemented as `Number(b.new) - Number(a.new)` (boolean ordering) — works for prototype but a real implementation should use a createdAt timestamp.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested flows verified working on https://libra-marketplace.preview.emergentagent.com. Cart state does NOT persist across hard page reloads — use in-app navigation (Link/router) when chaining cart -> checkout in scripts, OR call page.goto for the empty-cart scenario. Cart drawer auto-opens on add-to-cart; subsequent nav-cart-btn click is blocked unless drawer is first closed. Sort 'low' first product is replacement-knob ($7), Sort 'high' first is wall-art-panel ($89, sold-out). home-decor category has 2 products.
